description: This file defines the ConnectionFactoryLoader class, a utility class responsible for loading and providing access to the ConnectionFactory instance within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles dynamic class instantiation based on configuration and includes error handling and logging.

classes.name: ConnectionFactoryLoader
classes.description: Utility class for loading and accessing the singleton ConnectionFactory instance.

methods.name: createConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates and initializes the singleton ConnectionFactory instance based on the current configuration, with error handling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton ConnectionFactory instance, throwing an exception if it has not been initialized.
